text:
Maya P: Quick question — when a user saves a query on a route that has multiple deployed models, should the saved query store a single pinned model, a list of candidate models, or just a routing hint? also how do we show quota preview for each option?

Jamal: I'm leaning to storing a pinned model id + fallback list. Keeps UX simple and allows automatic fallback when pinned is down.

Robin: +1 on pin+fallback but UX needs to surface that the preview cost changes if fallback triggers. Users get surprised when quota estimate jumps.

Sasha: Telemetry note: we need to capture which model actually served each request for saved-query rollouts. Sampling + per-request model tag.

Maya P: good point. How granular should the preview be? per-token estimates per-model?

Jamal: we can show a weighted estimate based on recent routing mix. Example: 70% model-a (q4) + 30% model-b (q2) -> blended cost.

Robin: can we compute that on the fly? might be heavy. Maybe precompute hourly and show "last hour blended estimate".

Sasha: Implementation sketch:
```
saved_query: {
  route_id: "r-123",
  pinned_model: "m-a-v2",
  fallbacks: ["m-b-v1","m-c-quant"],
  preview: {
    blended_cost: 0.0123,
    sample_window: "1h",
    sample_counts: {"m-a-v2":700,"m-b-v1":300}
  }
}
```

Maya P: That looks solid. UX question: where do we show pin vs fallback? In save modal? in route header?

Jamal: put a compact badge in route header + full detail in the saved-query drawer. Badge could be "Pinned: m-a-v2 (fallbacks: 2)".

Robin: Also add a small tooltip: "Preview cost assumes current routing mix — may change during rollouts." :warning: 

console-bot: Design doc uploaded — link: https://redwood.internal/docs/pinned-models-for-saved-queries :point_right: 

Sasha: One more — auth/permissions. Enterprise customers may want to prevent pinning to non-approved models. Add an ACL flag on saved_query: allow_pinning: boolean.

Maya P: ok actionable list: 1) API shape + preview calc (Jamal) 2) telemetry tagging (Sasha) 3) badge + drawer UI (Robin) 4) permission flag (Maya)

Jamal: I'll draft the API PR today.

Robin: I'll mock the badge + drawer.

Sasha: I'll add telemetry events and a sampling job.

Maya P: Thanks — will sync in next PM sync. :thumbsup:
